rec.name: PDP Product Attributes (Customer Rating Sliders)
rec.status: Built — approved for merge into live theme

what.text: A PDP block titled "What our customers say" (German: "Was unsere Kund*innen sagen"). It sits inside a rounded, light-grey card below the add-to-cart button, payment icons and shipping/returns USP row. The card shows several horizontal slider-style scales, one per attribute (Look, Feeling, Vibe). Each scale has a bold attribute label, a white track with a dark pill marker and two end labels (e.g. "not good" / "very good", "short-lived" / "long-lasting", "wobbly" / "robust"). A centered word ("gut" = "good") appears under some scales, apparently as the summary rating. The markers are read-only indicators of aggregated customer feedback, not interactive controls.

why.text: It condenses customer opinion into a quick, scannable visual near the buy button. This is social proof, with the average perception of quality attributes shown as a position on a scale. It reduces uncertainty about qualities that are hard to judge online, such as durability, feel and sturdiness. Bipolar scales are processed faster than review text and answer the buyer's likely objections right at the decision point.

how.text: Built as a custom Shopify theme block ("CRO | Product Attributes") that can be placed in the PDP product-info section. It requires Metaobjects and Metafields to be set up first, which hold the attribute names, end labels, marker positions and summary words. Setup documentation is referenced in the block settings. The theme editor controls spacing, desktop visibility, corner radius, text and background colors, and heading typography. A text color option was added after the request for white text, and the block was approved to be merged into the live theme.

items: CRO Heading: font-size (18), letter-spacing (0), font-weight (600), font-style (Normal/Italic)

dependencies.text: Requires Shopify Metaobjects and Metafields to be set up before use (stated in the block's settings panel). The exact schema (fields, definitions) is not documented in the ticket. Assumes a theme with a product-info section that accepts custom blocks. Text and background color fields show database icons, suggesting they can be bound to dynamic sources.

Return rate for products with the block (secondary)
